Definition
[Lorentz Metric]

↗ def:pseudo-metric-has-signature

A Lorentz metric is a pseudo-Riemannian metric of index $1$, hence of signature $(r,1)$ for some $r\geq 0$. A pseudo-Riemannian manifold carrying such a metric is a Lorentz manifold.

On an $n$-manifold a Lorentz metric has signature $(n-1,1)$. The metric $\bar g^{(r,1)}$ on $\mathbb R^{r,1}$ is the Minkowski metric; writing its coordinates as $(\xi ^1,\ldots ,\xi ^r,\tau )$, \begin{equation} \bar g^{(r,1)}=(d\xi ^1)^2+\cdots +(d\xi ^r)^2-(d\tau )^2. \tag {2.25} \end{equation}
